summary.text: Diane Mullins is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 47 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A pastor and a founder of Deborah’s Voice, she serves on the Agriculture, Community Revitalization, Medicaid and Public Safety committees.

paragraphs.text: Mullins’ career experience includes working as a pastor, and she is a founder of Deborah’s Voice, according to Ballotpedia.
She ran unsuccessfully in the 2020 Republican primary for Ohio House District 53, losing to Thomas Hall.
In 2024 she defeated incumbent Sara Carruthers in the Republican primary for District 47 and then defeated Democrat Vanessa Cummings in the general election, assuming office on January 1, 2025.
In the 2025–2026 session Mullins was assigned to the Agriculture, Community Revitalization (as vice chair), Medicaid and Public Safety committees.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
